name: Martifer SGPS, S.A.
summary: Martifer SGPS, S.A. operates in the metallic constructions and renewable energy development sectors in Portugal, Angola, Saudi Arabia, Europe, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Metallic Constructions, Naval Industry, and Renewables. The Metallic Constructions segment engages in the metallic constructions, construction of ships, aluminum and glass facades, industrial maintenance, and infrastructure for oil and gas activities. The Naval Industry segment offers ship repair and conversion services.
